title: Two-disjoint-cycle-cover vertex pancyclicity of split-star networks
summary: Let $r_1$ and $r_2$ be positive integers with $r_1 \le r_2$. A graph $G$ is called $2$-DCC vertex $[r_1,r_2]$-pancyclic if, for any two distinct vertices of $G$ and any integer $\ell \in [r_1,r_2]$, there exist two vertex-disjoint cycles of lengths $\ell$ and $|V(G)|-\ell$, respectively, containing the two vertices separately. In this paper, we investigate the two-disjoint-cycle-cover vertex pancyclicity of the split-star network $S_n^2$. We prove that $S_n^2$ is $2$-DCC vertex $[3,n!/2]$-pancyclic for $n\ge4$.
